messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they say "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6." That seems like they want to compute the p-value for a t-test? They mention "零假設檢定的標準差" which might be the standard error? Or maybe they want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution? The phrase "以得到人口平均值為98.6" means "to get the population mean of 98.6". So they want to test H0: μ = 98.6 vs Ha: μ ≠ 98.6? They have sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, n=40. They want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution (standard error) and then compute the p-value? The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" It might be asking to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution (i.e., standard error). That would be sample_std_dev / sqrt(n) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40) ≈ 6.3249. 1.4 / 6.3249 ≈ 0.2213. So standard error ~0.2213.

But the phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" could also refer to the standard deviation of the sampling distribution under the null hypothesis. That is indeed the standard error. So answer: 0.2213.

Alternatively, they might want to compute the p-value. But the question explicitly says "計算...的標準差". So we should compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution. So answer: 0.2213.

We can also provide the p-value if needed. But the question only asks for the standard deviation. So we will give the standard error.

Thus answer: 0.2213.
